title: Home Oxygen Therapy Clinical Standard: Training Deliveries Made Ahead of the Patient's Return Home
content:
# Training Deliveries Ahead of the Return Home — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Clause.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy setup, the patient's first day at home replaces the initial-setup delivery date only when the initial-setup delivery came no more than the allowance below before the first day at home:

- **2 days** for an order from a hospital discharge or a skilled nursing facility when the coverage named on the oxygen record is Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement Plan G, Medicare Advantage PPO, Medicare Advantage HMO, Commercial PPO or Commercial HMO;
- **1 day** for an order from a hospital discharge or a skilled nursing facility under any other coverage class;
- **0 days** for any other order.

The coverage class is read from the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records for the coverage the oxygen record names; the referral source is read from the oxygen record. The gap is counted in calendar days as the later date minus the earlier date. When this condition fails, the setup day stays the initial-setup delivery date.

## Allowance table

| Referral source of the order | Coverage class named on the oxygen record | Longest gap between the initial-setup delivery and the first day at home |
|---|---|---|
| hospital discharge or skilled nursing facility | Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement Plan G, Medicare Advantage PPO, Medicare Advantage HMO, Commercial PPO, Commercial HMO | 2 days |
| hospital discharge or skilled nursing facility | any other class (for example Medicaid Fee-for-Service) | 1 day |
| any other source | any | 0 days |

## Both sides of each figure (hypothetical dates, first day at home 10 April)

| Referral source | Coverage class | Initial-setup delivery | Gap | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| skilled nursing facility | Commercial PPO | 8 April | 2 days | met |
| hospital discharge | Original Medicare Part B | 7 April | 3 days | fails: setup day stays 7 April |
| hospital discharge | Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 9 April | 1 day | met |
| skilled nursing facility | Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 8 April | 2 days | fails: setup day stays 8 April |
| any other source | any | 10 April | 0 days | met |

## Points of judgement

**How is the gap counted?** In calendar days, the later date (the first day at home) less the earlier date (the initial-setup delivery).

**Do hospital discharge and skilled nursing facility orders differ here?** No; both take the same allowance, which turns on the coverage class.
